text.tspan: Number of new state-based conflicts World
Included are interstate, intrastate, and extrasystemic conflicts that started that year.

tspan.tspan: Uppsala Conflict Data Program and Peace Research Institute Oslo (2026)
Some conflicts affect several regions, and do not necessarily start at the same time across them. The sum across all regions can therefore

text.tspan: be higher than the global number.
